text:
maria: Heads up — need a region quota bump in us-west-2 for an upcoming customer rollout. We're targeting ~24 p4d instances with multiple ENIs per node (monitoring, metrics, sidecars). Current limits are blocking subnet IPs and ENI count.

liam: Can you list the specific quotas you want increased? AWS names (e.g., "Elastic IPs", "Network interfaces", "IPv4 addresses per subnet") are helpful.

maria: Sure — request list: 
- EC2 Network Interfaces (regional) -> target 2000
- IPv4 addresses per VPC/subnet -> expand affected subnets from /26 to /22 (we need ~4000 IPs)
- ENI-per-instance limit for p4d (we're planning secondary ENIs for monitoring)
- AWS PrivateLink endpoints per VPC -> 150
- EFA quota (for RDMA on a subset) -> 50

sunil: Why so many ENIs? Could we use VPC CNI IP address per pod or prefix delegation instead of 8 ENIs per instance? That reduces ENI demand.

maria: We evaluated CNI. Customer requires isolated ENIs for NIC-level traffic shaping and vendor sidecars that rely on dedicated interfaces. Also want to attach throughput-limited ENIs to separate subnets for traffic egress policy.

liam: Ok. For subnet resize — are you planning to re-IP the node pools or create new subnets and migrate? That affects downtime and route table changes.

maria: Prefer new subnets and in-place node replacement. Plan: create /22 in each AZ, deploy quietly, cordon/drain GPU nodes and relaunch. Minimal downtime.

rachel: FYI this will increase NAT gateway egress costs if we expand NAT capacity. Estimate: +$2000/month if we add two more NATs. Pinged billing.

aws-bot: AWS Support case created: 1234567891. Summary: "Quota increase request - EC2 network interfaces, IPv4 addresses per subnet, VPC endpoints". ETA: 48-72 hours for initial review. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1234567891

infra-oncall: Filed internal change request (CHG-2026-0412) to track subnet creation and route propagation. Scheduled dry-run tomorrow 16:00 PST. @liam can you join?

liam: I'll join the dry-run. Quick checklist: 
- Update aws-auth/iam for new ENI attach roles
- Confirm secondary IP assignment automation works with kubelet
- Update security groups to include new ENI prefixes

sunil: Also confirm kernel parameter tweaks for dpdk/hugepages on the new nodes (p4d). Won't hurt to add that to terraform module.

maria: Terraform snippet to create a /22 subnet we're planning to run (put in infra repo):
```hcl
resource "aws_subnet" "gpu_private_a" {
  vpc_id     = var.vpc_id
  cidr_block = "10.40.0.0/22"
  availability_zone = "us-west-2a"
  tags = { Name = "gpu-private-a" }
}
```

rachel: Cost note — moving to /22 increases ENI provisioning headroom. Recommend we enable prefix delegation and IP reuse for k8s to save address space long-term. But acknowledge customer's isolation requirement.

maria: For PrivateLink endpoints, we'll need limit bump because we serve three internal services (model-registry, telemetry, config) per-account. Requesting 150 to be safe.

aws-bot: Support updated. Case 1234567891: added request for VPC endpoints quota to 150.

infra-oncall: Created a short runbook for the migration, added rollback steps and validation (latency, packet loss, GPU health). Dropping link in the repo after dry-run.

liam: One more ask — if AWS denies ENI quota increase, fallback plan is to consolidate sidecars onto fewer ENIs and use hostNetwork for metrics. That impacts isolation but is workable short-term.

maria: Agree. I'll wait for AWS confirmation. If approved, we'll proceed with dry-run and then scale to full 24 p4d nodes.

sunil: Thanks. Please post the AWS case updates here when they come in. Also add the subnet CIDRs to IPAM doc.

aws-bot: Case 1234567891 status: "Case updated by AWS: Needs justification" — requested additional architecture details. Reply added by maria.

maria: Replied with node count, ENI usage matrix, and security justification.

liam: Good. If AWS pushes back on PrivateLink limits, we can split services across VPCs and peer/TransitGW, but that's more ops.

rachel: Billing flags noted. If NAT egress increases, we'll look at S3 VPC endpoints for model artifact traffic to cut costs.

infra-oncall: Marking thread for follow-up. Will update first_message_ts when AWS gives final approval.

maria: Thanks all — will keep updates coming. :thumbsup:
